source:
@@U03949@@
we Dryads, spirits of trees, lure lightly,
teasing, coaxing the springs of life
to rise from roots into trembling twigs.
Then we deck them out with leaves,
lavish them with lovely blossoms,
adorning our hair for prosperous growth.
And when the ripe fruit falls, they'll gather,
folks and flocks, to reap and nibble,
pressing on in eager masses,
everyone bowed down to earth,
as once they bowed to ancient gods.

@@U03951@@
Mountain nymphs, Oreads are we,
who cling here, gently caressing, close to
smooth-polished rocks that reflect afar.
We will hearken, we will listen
for every sound, for songs of birds,
for fluting reeds, even for Great Pan's
fearsome shout: for every one
we have an answer always ready.
To a rustling wind we rustle back;
to the thunder’s clap we clap, and again,
and again and again till we're all clapped out.

@@U03953@@
Sisters, Naiads, water spirits,
we, more lively-minded than they,
will wander on with swiftly flowing
brooks that lure us to well-wooded hills.
Ever downward, ever deeper,
we will water now the meadows,
next the pastures, then, ah, then,
the lovely gardens that circle the houses.
We'll know the place by the slender line
of cypresses that tower above
the landscape, shore, and mirroring sea.
PUMUIS IE, DAR Iwie) Oo 5ysi5)
translation:
@@U03949@@
我们树精，树精，轻轻地引诱，
戏弄、哄动生命之泉
从根部长成颤抖的树枝。
然后我们用树叶装饰它们，
给它们开满美丽的花朵，
装饰我们的头发，使其健康成长。
当成熟的果实落下时，它们就会聚集，
人们和羊群，去收割和啃食，
在热切的群众中前进，
所有人都跪倒在地，
就像他们曾经向古代诸神鞠躬一样。

@@U03951@@
山中仙女，奥瑞德就是我们，
谁依偎在这里，温柔地爱抚，靠近
光滑的岩石反射出远处的光彩。
我们会倾听，我们会倾听
为了每一种声音，为了鸟儿的歌声，
适用于凹槽簧片，甚至适用于 Great Pan 簧片
可怕的呼喊：对于每个人
我们随时准备好答案。
伴随着沙沙的风，我们沙沙作响；
伴随着雷鸣般的掌声，我们再次鼓掌，
一次又一次，直到我们都鼓掌为止。

@@U03953@@
姐妹们，水仙，水精灵，
我们比他们活泼，
会随着急流而去
溪流引诱我们前往树木茂盛的山丘。
一直向下，越来越深，
我们现在要给草地浇水，
接下来是牧场, 然后, 啊, 然后,
房子周围有美丽的花园。
我们会通过细线知道这个地方
高耸的柏树
风景、海岸和镜像的大海。
PUMUIS IE、DAR Iwie) Oo 5ysi5)
